title: blob.rs percent_encode: byte as char cast — prefer char::from(byte)
description: blob.rs line 85: out.push(byte as char) — the as cast for numeric-to-char conversion is not idiomatic Rust; it silently truncates for values > 127. char::from(byte) is explicit about converting a u8 (valid ASCII guaranteed by the preceding is_ascii_alphanumeric/branch guards), and clippy::as_conversions flags unbounded as casts. While the existing guards make this safe, char::from(byte) communicates intent and is clippy-preferred.
